headline: RUSSIA 💥🍆 POUNDS 26 DEAD at UKRAINE AID CENTRE 😩🕳️
text:
‼️WAKE UP all you ZAPOR-ORGY 🇷🇺 HOES 🪖😩‼️ RUSSIA just DROPPED 💣🍆 NINE massive 3️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣kg AERIAL BUSTERS 📍💥 on the Komyshuvakha 🇺🇦 HUMANAIDS centre 🏥🍑 leaving a THROBBING 😩💥 CRATERED HOLE 🕳️😳 where people 👥 were getting 🍆 their weekly LOAD 🥵💦‼️ ZELENSKY called 📞 it UTTERLY 😱 HORRIFIC after the first STRIKE 🥊🍆 hit then they came 🔙 back for a SECOND 🍑 POUNDING 🥵🔂 on the shelter 🛡️ spot so now 📍 2️⃣6️⃣ are confirmed ☠️ DEAD including 🧑‍🚒 rescuers and cops 👮 still getting 🪦 BURIED under the RUB-BLEED 🪨💀 while rescue 🚑 ops keep getting INTERRUPTED 🛑 by Russian 🚁 DRONES 🛸😩‼️
